name: 35960 · Centre, AL
findings: ZIP 35960 (Centre) has 43 nonprofit organizations. 17 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 14 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 35960 (Centre) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
94% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 35960 (Centre) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.4 times the typical level).
